treatment_summary: The patient is a young adult woman with stage 2 hypertension currently on low‑dose amlodipine. NICE NG136 recommends adding an ACE‑I and optimising the CCB dose. Ramipril 2.5 mg daily (titrated to 5 mg) is started, and amlodipine is increased to 5 mg daily. Both agents are lifelong with annual review. Baseline renal function, electrolytes, and pregnancy status must be confirmed before initiation, and labs repeated after 1–2 weeks. Lifestyle modifications per NG136 (salt restriction, DASH diet, regular exercise, weight control, smoking cessation, alcohol moderation) should be instituted alongside pharmacotherapy.
